title: Wabi-sabi for Artists, Designers, Poets & Philosophers
author: Leonard Koren
description: DESCRIPTION The term wabi-sabi indicates impermanence, humility, asymmetry, and imperfection. Such underlying principles are diametrically opposed to those of their Western counterparts, whose beliefs are grounded in a Hellenic ethos that emphasizes longevity, grandeur, harmony and beauty.
